online-therapy-tri-cities-wa.title: Online Individual Therapy for Adults in the Tri-Cities
online-therapy-tri-cities-wa.eyebrow: Serving Kennewick, Pasco, Richland, and West Richland online
online-therapy-tri-cities-wa.summary: Meet with an M.F.T. clinician by secure video from a private location in Washington. Explore clinician fit, payment options, and appointment availability without traveling to our Woodinville office.
online-therapy-tri-cities-wa.note: A consultation is optional for individual care. You may request an initial clinical evaluation directly. Consultations are not therapy sessions or diagnostic evaluations. Appointment requests are subject to confirmation.
online-therapy-tri-cities-wa.location: We serve eligible Tri-Cities clients online. Our physical office is in Woodinville, Washington; we do not have a Tri-Cities branch office. Telehealth depends on clinician availability, clinical fit, and your physical location at the time of the appointment.

gary-ashley.primary: Request an Online Appointment With Gary
gary-ashley.summary: Explore Gary's approach and request an online individual appointment. Telehealth availability and suitability are confirmed as part of the scheduling process.

sonia-hassan-bio.primary: Request an Online Appointment With Sonia
sonia-hassan-bio.summary: Explore Sonia's approach and request an online individual appointment. Telehealth availability and suitability are confirmed as part of the scheduling process.

new-page.summary: Individual therapy in Woodinville or online for eligible Washington clients. Request an initial clinical evaluation directly, or choose an optional consultation first.
new-page.note: Coverage and out-of-pocket costs depend on your plan, benefits, service, and clinician. Confirm those details before care. Consultations are not therapy sessions or diagnostic evaluations. Appointment requests are subject to confirmation.

marriage-and-couples-therapy-counseling.summary: Couples consultations and couples therapy sessions are private pay. Start with a couples consultation; your clinician will guide the next assessment and session steps.
marriage-and-couples-therapy-counseling.note: Begin with the required 30-minute couples consultation, then one separate evaluation for each partner, before the first 53-minute couples session. An optional 10-minute phone introduction does not replace these steps. Appointment requests are subject to confirmation.

gettingStarted.title: Choose a clinician
gettingStarted.text: Read about the clinicians' approaches and confirm which services, age groups, appointment formats, and payment options they currently offer.

gettingStarted.title: Choose how to begin
gettingStarted.text: Request an initial clinical evaluation, or choose an optional consultation to discuss fit and the care process. Any applicable consultation fee should be clear before requesting it.

gettingStarted.title: Meet online when appropriate
gettingStarted.text: After your appointment is confirmed, follow the practice's instructions for your online visit. Have a private setting and confirm your physical location with your clinician.

questions.question: Do I need to travel to Woodinville?
questions.answer: Not for an appointment confirmed as telehealth. Our physical office is in Woodinville; this page describes online care for eligible Washington clients.

questions.question: Do I need a consultation first?
questions.answer: For individual care, consultations are optional. You can request an initial clinical evaluation directly. A consultation is not a therapy session or diagnostic evaluation.

questions.question: Can I use insurance?
questions.answer: Coverage and out-of-pocket costs depend on your plan, benefits, service, and clinician. Confirm those details before care. A listed insurance company does not guarantee coverage for every clinician or appointment.

questions.question: Does clicking the button book an appointment?
questions.answer: No. It opens our appointment-request process in SimplePractice. Your requested appointment must be confirmed.
